subject.title: feat: show a relocating status footer on in-flight channel replies

question: Should `messages.statusFooter` default to visible `activity` behavior for existing edit-capable channel users, or remain opt-in until that product behavior is explicitly accepted?
rationale: This feature introduces a new configuration contract and changes visible intermediate-reply rendering for existing Telegram-capable deployments.

options.title: Make it opt-in
options.body: Default the footer to off and retain per-channel enablement until maintainer product direction supports changing existing users’ visible reply behavior.

options.title: Accept default activity
options.body: Keep the proposed default after maintainers explicitly accept the upgrade behavior and review real Telegram proof.

recommendation.title: Make it opt-in
recommendation.body: Default the footer to off and retain per-channel enablement until maintainer product direction supports changing existing users’ visible reply behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The available review context identifies steipete as the only concrete person associated with the implementation; repository-history routing was unavailable.
